title: The Form Marshes
tagline: Filling things in, and proving the page pushed back when it should.
teaches: fill, check, uncheck, select_option, press, and the negative cases most suites forget
objectives: Fill text inputs, radios, checkboxes and dropdowns with the method each one actually needs
Reach a field by its visible label instead of by the id a developer happened to choose
Write the negative case: prove the form REFUSES bad input, not just that it accepts good input
Generate your own test data so two runs never collide over the same email address
Explain why select_option() takes a value, a label or an index - and which one survives a redesign
plannedChallenges: Fill the signup form by label
Radios, checkboxes and the difference between check() and click()
Fix the broken test: it fills the box but never submits
The negative case: registering an email that already exists
Data that does not collide: unique_email() and why it exists
Boss: rebuild Test Case 6, the Contact Us form end to end
